traits.name: humble
traits.reason: Lines are full of hedges like "I think" and "if that is all right", and he reports his progress (nothing built yet) without boasting.

traits.name: persistent
traits.reason: He keeps walking and gathering across five wakes with no rest, moves farther out, and keeps looking for the big thing despite having built nothing.

traits.name: gentle
traits.reason: His greetings are soft and offer to share berries and wood, and he uses no sharp words. He does name peers in greetings, but there is no mockery.

traits.name: wistful
traits.reason: He says the big thing is probably still ahead and that it is good at waiting, and he notes nothing is built yet, all without complaint.
